class.name: JRPGFormula
class.brief_description: A damage formula such as a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2.
class.description: Evaluates a skill or item formula with Godot's [Expression]. [code]a[/code] is the user and [code]b[/code] the target (see [JRPGFormulaBattler]), and [code]v[n][/code] reads game variable [code]n[/code]. Formulas may also use the functions [code]abs[/code], [code]min[/code], [code]max[/code], [code]clamp[/code], [code]floor[/code], [code]ceil[/code], [code]round[/code], [code]sqrt[/code] and [code]sign[/code], plus [code]iff(condition, if_true, if_false)[/code] and [code]roll(low, high)[/code], which draws from the battle random stream. The words [code]true[/code], [code]false[/code], [code]and[/code], [code]or[/code] and [code]not[/code] are allowed too. Any other name is refused when the formula is set, so formulas stay deterministic and cannot call engine functions. When both operands are integers, [code]/[/code] divides as integers ([code]7 / 2[/code] is 3); write [code]7.0 / 2[/code] for 3.5.

method.name: check_identifiers
method.description: Returns an empty string if every name in [param text] is allowed in a formula, otherwise a message naming the first one that is not.

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Evaluates the formula with user [param a], target [param b], the game [param variables] (index = variable ID) and the battle [param random] stream, and returns the result rounded to an integer (half away from zero, kept within ±2^62). [code]v[n][/code] with a literal [code]n[/code] past the end of [param variables] reads 0, like a variable never set. An empty formula gives 0; an invalid formula, a runtime error, NaN and infinity give 0 and print one warning per formula.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns why the formula is invalid, or an empty string.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the formula text is set and passed the checks and parsing.

method.name: set_text
method.description: Sets and checks the formula text. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_PARSE_ERROR] when it uses a name that is not allowed or cannot be parsed.
